notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.102

• Duckling sees pictures: send DuckAI a photo and Duckling looks at it itself, on your phone, no account or key needed. It switches by itself: pictures go to its eyes, words to its brain. Its eyes download once over Wi-Fi (3 GB).
• Camera: the lens's optical stabilisation is on, and the camera's own noise reduction and sharpening run at their best settings.
